technical.summary: IBM shows strong long-term trend structure (golden cross, above key MAs) but is overbought on multiple oscillators with momentum divergence signals and declining volume, creating elevated pullback risk despite bullish technicals.

fundamental.summary: IBM shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 83 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: medium — moderate amounts, senior member (McCaul) with two purchases
sentiment.summary: Modest congressional buying by senior Republican (McCaul) 70 days ago combined with fear-zone market sentiment presents mild contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and neutral AAII sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress with inverted yield curve, crisis VIX (281), rising dollar, and FOMC event just passed; IBM faces significant headwinds despite 83-day earnings buffer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross, ADX trending, and Ichimoku above cloud establish strong long-term structure with congressional buying by senior member (McCaul) in fear-zone market sentiment providing contrarian support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI 80.25, Stoch 83.44), momentum divergence (MACD crossover down, RSI 9/14 not rising), three black crows pattern, declining volume (0.81 ratio), and macro crisis (inverted yield curve, VIX 281, rising DXY) create imminent pullback risk with no fundamental conviction.

decision.entry_rationale: Golden cross and Ichimoku structure offer long-term bullish framework, but entry timing is poor with RSI 80.25 and Stoch 83.44 signaling imminent pullback risk in a macro crisis environment.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme overbought conditions combined with inverted yield curve, VIX 281, and MACD downward crossover create high probability of 5-10% pullback before trend continuation.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on elevated pullback risk despite bullish structure
decision.portfolio_note: Existing IBM position and 15 open Information Technology positions create sector concentration; skip entry and monitor for pullback to EMA 50 or golden cross support before reconsidering.
